title: fsrs_params.updated
description: Sets a subset of a preset's registers. A winning write to any register except 'name' forces a replay of every card on the preset. OPS.md#fsrs_paramsupdated

id.description: Id of the preset. Equals the envelope's entity_id.

set.description: Registers to write. At least one.

maximum_interval_days.description: Register 'maximum_interval_days'. Column default 36500. At most 36500 (C-6, = the API bound): it caps every derived interval, so card.due_at stays within Postgres timestamptz whatever desired_retention is (SYNC.md 2.1 storable values).

learning_steps_s.description: Register 'learning_steps_s': steps in seconds, in order; [] = none.

relearning_steps_s.description: Register 'relearning_steps_s': steps in seconds, in order; [] = none.

easy_days.description: Register 'easy_days': load multiplier per ISO weekday, Monday first. Column default [1,1,1,1,1,1,1].
